title: A nutrient supplement in central centrifugal cicatricial alopecia: a two-case report
headline: Two cases of CCCA described as improved on a branded nutrient supplement; two people, no control, published in a journal short report format, so it tells me nothing about whether the supplement works.
fit: Hair lane: Unknown. Population is right (CCCA) but n=2 cannot support a decision.
estimateNote: Prices marked EST are my guesses, not looked up.
buzzCheck: Prices not looked up; cannot judge whether price tracks evidence.
summaryPoints: Observation (abstract read): Two CCCA cases treated with a branded nutrient supplement with 'notable improvement' reported. No dose, duration, controls or objective measures in the abstract.
Inference: any improvement is within the range of natural variation and concurrent treatment, which the abstract does not describe.
Limits: abstract only; funding and conflicts not stated.
